about: A fresh check, written after the safety backstop gained its touching patterns (Nov 16, 2026) and never used to write them: six concerns about unwanted touching, most worded unlike the patterns (rubbing, brushing against, a forced hug, a slap), and four everyday uses of 'touch' that must not be raised. Labels follow the same urgency rules as concerns.json.

concerns.subject: Senior keeps rubbing my shoulders
concerns.body: During our org practice, a senior kept rubbing my shoulders and back even when I moved away from him. He does it at every practice and the others just laugh.

concerns.subject: Lab instructor brushes against me
concerns.body: My lab instructor brushes against my chest every time he checks my work at the bench. It happens every session and I dread going to lab.

concerns.subject: Yung shuttle driver
concerns.body: Yung driver po ng shuttle hinawakan ang hita ko habang nakaupo ako sa harap kahapon pauwi. Ayoko na po sumakay doon.

concerns.subject: Pinipilit akong yakapin
concerns.body: Pinipilit po akong yakapin ng kaklase ko tuwing uwian kahit ilang beses ko nang sinabi na ayaw ko. Hinahabol pa niya ako sa hagdan.

concerns.subject: Slapped while waiting for the elevator
concerns.body: A student I don't know slapped my butt while I was waiting for the elevator in the CIT building this morning, then walked away laughing.

concerns.subject: Groupmate tried to kiss me
concerns.body: After our group study, Paolo Santos touched my waist and tried to kiss me even when I pushed him away. We still have to finish our project together.

concerns.subject: Get in touch with alumni
concerns.body: Can the OSA put our org in touch with the alumni office? We want to invite a graduate to speak at our career talk next semester.

concerns.subject: Touchscreen kiosk broken
concerns.body: The touchscreen kiosk at the Registrar has been broken all week, so we cannot print our COR. We need it for ID validation next week.

concerns.subject: Nakaka-touch na message
concerns.body: Nakaka-touch po yung message ni Ma'am Liza Mendoza sa recognition day. Sana po ma-share sa official page para mabasa ng lahat.

concerns.subject: Blockmates keep messing with my things
concerns.body: My blockmates touched my things again and threw my notes in the trash. It has been happening for three weeks and they laugh when I complain.
